title: NALCO Non Executive Admit Card 2026
vacancyDetails: Non-Executive posts (around 255–268 across trades) for Damanjodi / Angul complexes
qualification: 10th + ITI / trade qualifications as per NALCO non-executive advertisement
ageLimit: 18 to 27–40 years post-wise as per notification
applicationFee: As per NALCO / IBPS process fee if any
selectionProcess: Online CBT → Trade Test / Skill (if any) → Document Verification → Medical
documentsRequired: Registration Number/Roll Number and password/DOB; printed admit card; photo ID
howToApply:
1. Visit https://mudira.nalcoindia.co.in or nalcoindia.com careers
2. Open Non-Executive Admit Card login
3. Enter registration credentials
4. Download hall ticket
5. Appear for CBT as per date on admit card
shortDescription: NALCO Non-Executive Admit Card 2026 released on 15 July 2026 for ~268 posts. Download from NALCO recruitment portal.
content:
National Aluminium Company Limited (NALCO) has released the admit card for Non-Executive Personnel recruitment 2026 on around 15 July 2026.

Recruitment covers M&R Complex Damanjodi and related non-executive trades. Online applications were open from late May 2026.

Download hall ticket using registration credentials from the official NALCO recruitment portal and carry original photo ID on exam day.
